narration.full_text: Namaste students! In this section, we'll explore the fascinating world of control and coordination in living organisms. We'll uncover how both plants and animals manage their internal and external environments to survive and thrive. By the end of this lesson, you will be able to understand how organisms respond to stimuli. You will learn about the structure and function of the nervous system, including neurons and reflex actions. We'll also delve into the components and roles of the human brain. Furthermore, you will discover how plants coordinate their activities through hormones. Finally, we will examine the animal endocrine system and its major hormones.
